description: The Psi Knight harnesses psion­ic energy to enhance combat abilities.

features.name: Psionic Power
features.description: Gain Psi Points equal to fighter level. Spend to fuel telekinetic feats and mental fortitude.

features.name: Telekinetic Movement
features.description: Use reaction to move object or creature within 30 feet when you're hit by attack.

features.name: Telekinetic Mastery
features.description: When using maneuver, spend Psi Point to knock creature prone or move it 5 feet.

features.name: Guarded Mind
features.description: Immunity to magic that allows other creatures to sense your emotions or thoughts.
